name: Print Sheet
description: Lay one design - or a whole pile of them - out n-up on A4, Letter or A3, across as many pages as it takes, with crop marks in the margin.
a11yLabel: Print sheet, {{default rowsOut rows}} rows by {{default colsOut cols}} columns

examples.label: QR codes, 3 x 3 to cut apart

inputs.label: Artwork
inputs.help: Drop in one design or a whole pile - each becomes a cell you can cut apart. Paste a LOLLY TOOL LINK (a share link from any tool - a name badge, a QR code, a card) and that tool renders live into its cell and re-renders whenever the sheet is opened. One design fills the whole sheet; several cycle across the cells. Tap any cell on the sheet to swap what is in it, and Batch or Multi-edit can send a whole run straight here.

inputs.label: Fill
inputs.help: Repeat cycles your designs to fill every cell of every page - one design makes a full sheet of the same thing, several make a mixed sheet. Each once places every design a single time and adds pages until they all fit - a proof sheet.

inputs.label: Pages
inputs.help: How many sheets to print. Each is the same grid; the designs keep cycling across them so neighbouring pages stay varied. Each once sets its own page count.

inputs.label: Sheet
inputs.help: Paper size. Picking one also sets the export page size, so the PDF comes out at true scale.

inputs.label: Rows
inputs.help: Cells down each sheet. Rows times columns is capped at 40 cells a sheet.

inputs.label: Gap
inputs.help: Space between cells, in millimetres. Zero butts them edge to edge for a single cut between neighbours.

inputs.label: Sheet margin
inputs.help: Unprinted border, in millimetres. The crop marks live here, and most desktop printers cannot print closer than about 5 mm to the paper edge.

inputs.label: Crop marks
inputs.help: Short lines in the margin off every cell edge, to line a guillotine or a knife up on.

inputs.label: Cut shape
inputs.help: Straight cut leaves the cells square. Rounded corners add a dashed die line around each cell, the sticker-sheet shape.
